title: BC Friday Tips #55 CaptionClass
summary: CaptionClass is a property that creates dynamic captions changing based on data or context, with dimension fields as a common example. It helps build flexible, context-aware captions using reference codeunits from the base application.
key_points: CaptionClass property enables dynamic captions that adapt based on data or setup context
Dimension fields use CaptionClass to automatically update captions based on dimension configuration
Seven codeunits in the base application implement CaptionClass as reusable references
Allows extension developers to create flexible, context-aware field captions

quotes.text: It lets you create dynamic captions that change based on data or context
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core value of CaptionClass - enabling flexible, adaptive captions in extensions

quotes.text: All Dimension fields use the CaptionClass property.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides a concrete example showing how CaptionClass is already used in standard Business Central for dimension handling

quotes.text: There are 7 Codeunits in the Base Application that implement CaptionClass, including Dimension CaptionClass Mgmt.
quotes.why_it_matters: Directs developers to reference implementations they can study and learn from when building their own solutions
